Textual reuse analysis generated by DharmaNexus identifies 60 matching passages shared across 12 Pali texts, most extensively with the commentary *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo), with which it shares 36 matches (notably between verses §3.4–6.3 and commentary sections §1292–1297) [DharmaNexus]. The text also exhibits formulaic verse sharing with several other *apadāna* poems in the collection, including the *Pañcahatthiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 186), *Naḷinakesariyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 245), *Mahāparivārakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 113), and the immediately following *Nipannañjalikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 85), along with *Kuṭajapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 183), *Nāgakesariyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 244), and others [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignment, DharmaNexus reports a low-scoring match with the Tibetan translation of the *Bhadrakalpikā-sūtra* (D0094), though this is an uncurated machine alignment rather than an established parallel [DharmaNexus].
